# Scanline tear

Bands of scanlines slip sideways and wrap around, with an optional sinusoidal wobble, like a TV losing horizontal sync.

<EffectDemo effect="scanline-tear" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { scanlineTear } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/scanline-tear';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(scanlineTear({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.amount = 0.03`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type    | Default | Range     | Description                                         |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `amount`     | number  | `0.03`  | 0 – 0.3   | Largest sideways shift, as a fraction of the width. |
| `lineHeight` | number  | `6`     | 1 – 64 px | Height of a band that moves together.               |
| `frequency`  | number  | `0.15`  | 0 – 1     | Fraction of bands torn at any moment.               |
| `wave`       | number  | `0.3`   | 0 – 1     | Strength of a slow sinusoidal wobble.               |
| `speed`      | number  | `1`     | 0 – 10    | Speed of the wobble.                                |
| `seed`       | integer | `1`     | 0 – 9999  | Changes the random sequence.                        |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                           |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`   | `amount: 0.01`, `frequency: 0.08`, `wave: 0.15`    |
| `lostSync` | `amount: 0.12`, `frequency: 0.3`, `lineHeight: 12` |
| `wobble`   | `frequency: 0`, `wave: 1`, `amount: 0.04`          |
| `shredded` | `amount: 0.2`, `frequency: 0.5`, `lineHeight: 2`   |

Apply one with `scanlineTear({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`frequency: 0`, `wave: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 4.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/scanline-tear`, including the shared effect runtime.
